open Mathlib List.Vector Part
informal_statement: For any arithmetic operation \( f \) on vectors of natural numbers of length \( n \), and for each index \( i \) in a vector space of length \( m \), there exists a function \( g_i \) that converts a vector of \( m \) natural numbers into a single natural number. The composition of all these functions \( g_i \) followed by the application of \( f \) is equivalent to first applying each \( g_i \) to the original vector to convert it into a vector of natural numbers and then applying \( f \) to this resultant vector.
informal_proof:
First, we consider the arithmetic operation \( f \) defined on vectors of natural numbers with length \( n \).
For each index \( i \) in the range from \( 0 \) to \( n-1 \), we have a function \( g_i \) that takes a vector \( v \) of length \( m \) as input and outputs a single natural number. By defining the composition of these \( g_i \) functions, we effectively transform the original vector \( v \) into a new vector where each component is the result of applying \( g_i \) to \( v \).

The equivalence between the composition of \( g_i \) followed by \( f \) and the application of \( f \) after individually applying each \( g_i \) can be understood through the lens of function composition principles. In mathematics, function composition allows us to relate and substitute functions based on their definitions. Here, composing the \( g_i \) functions in succession and then applying \( f \) is structurally equivalent to first transforming \( v \) using each \( g_i \) separately and then passing the transformed vector through \( f \).

  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))

        (Primrec.eq.comp

        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)

        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp

def isEqNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n = m then 1 else 0

def isLtNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n < m then 1 else 0

def isLeNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

def isDvdNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∣ m then 1 else 0

@[simp] lemma isEqNat_pos_iff : 0 < isEqNat n m ↔ n = m := by simp[isEqNat]; by_cases n = m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLtNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLtNat n m ↔ n < m := by simp[isLtNat]; by_cases n < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLeNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLeNat n m ↔ n ≤ m := by simp[isLeNat]; by_cases n ≤ m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isDvdNat_pos_iff : 0 < isDvdNat n m ↔ n ∣ m := by simp[isDvdNat]; by_cases n ∣ m <;> simp[*]

def inv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isEqNat n 0

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

@[simp] lemma inv_zero : inv 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma inv_iff_ne_zero : inv n = 0 ↔ 0 < n := by simp[inv, isEqNat, zero_lt_iff]

@[simp] lemma inv_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : inv n = 0 := by simp[inv, isEqNat, h]

def or (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n + m)

lemma and_eq (n m : ℕ) : and n m = if 0 < n ∧ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp [mul_pos_iff, and, isLtNat]

lemma and_eq_one (n m : ℕ) : and n m = 1 ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq, imp_false, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

lemma pos_of_eq_one (h : n = 1) : 0 < n := by simp[h]

def isEqNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n = m then 1 else 0

def isLtNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n < m then 1 else 0

def isLeNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

def isDvdNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∣ m then 1 else 0

@[simp] lemma isEqNat_pos_iff : 0 < isEqNat n m ↔ n = m := by simp[isEqNat]; by_cases n = m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLtNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLtNat n m ↔ n < m := by simp[isLtNat]; by_cases n < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLeNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLeNat n m ↔ n ≤ m := by simp[isLeNat]; by_cases n ≤ m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isDvdNat_pos_iff : 0 < isDvdNat n m ↔ n ∣ m := by simp[isDvdNat]; by_cases n ∣ m <;> simp[*]

def inv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isEqNat n 0

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

@[simp] lemma inv_zero : inv 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma inv_iff_ne_zero : inv n = 0 ↔ 0 < n := by simp[inv, isEqNat, zero_lt_iff]

@[simp] lemma inv_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : inv n = 0 := by simp[inv, isEqNat, h]

@[simp] lemma pos_zero : pos 0 = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pos_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : pos n = 1 := by simp[pos, isLtNat, h]

def and (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n * m)

def or (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n + m)

lemma and_eq (n m : ℕ) : and n m = if 0 < n ∧ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp [mul_pos_iff, and, isLtNat]

lemma and_eq_one (n m : ℕ) : and n m = 1 ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq, imp_false, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

lemma or_eq (n m : ℕ) : or n m = if 0 < n ∨ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp[or, isLtNat]

@[simp] lemma and_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < and n m ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∧ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma or_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < or n m ↔ 0 < n ∨ 0 < m := by simp[or_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∨ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },

  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

lemma and_eq (n m : ℕ) : and n m = if 0 < n ∧ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp [mul_pos_iff, and, isLtNat]

lemma and_eq_one (n m : ℕ) : and n m = 1 ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq, imp_false, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

lemma or_eq (n m : ℕ) : or n m = if 0 < n ∨ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp[or, isLtNat]

@[simp] lemma and_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < and n m ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∧ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma or_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < or n m ↔ 0 < n ∨ 0 < m := by simp[or_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∨ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma inv_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < inv n ↔ ¬0 < n := by simp[inv]

@[simp] lemma pos_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < pos n ↔ 0 < n := by simp[pos]

def ball (n : ℕ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ := n.rec 1 (fun n ih => (φ n).pos.and ih)

@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },
    by intro h; exact ⟨h n (Nat.le_refl n), fun m hm => h m (le_of_lt hm)⟩⟩

@[simp] lemma ball_eq_zero_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 0 ↔ ∃ m < n, φ m = 0 := by
  simpa[-ball_pos_iff] using not_iff_not.mpr (ball_pos_iff (φ := φ) (n := n))

lemma ball_pos_iff_eq_one {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 1 ↔ 0 < ball n φ := by
  induction' n with n _ <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · constructor
    · intro h; simpa using pos_of_eq_one h
    · intro h; simpa[and_eq_one] using h

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop
  | zero {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 0)
  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)
  | add {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i + v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)

  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | comp {m n f} (g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ) :
    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

evaluate using the "bignum" representation (see `Nat`). The definition provided

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma pos_of_eq_one (h : n = 1) : 0 < n := by simp[h]

def isEqNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n = m then 1 else 0

def isLtNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n < m then 1 else 0

def isLeNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

def isDvdNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∣ m then 1 else 0

@[simp] lemma isEqNat_pos_iff : 0 < isEqNat n m ↔ n = m := by simp[isEqNat]; by_cases n = m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLtNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLtNat n m ↔ n < m := by simp[isLtNat]; by_cases n < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLeNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLeNat n m ↔ n ≤ m := by simp[isLeNat]; by_cases n ≤ m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isDvdNat_pos_iff : 0 < isDvdNat n m ↔ n ∣ m := by simp[isDvdNat]; by_cases n ∣ m <;> simp[*]

def inv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isEqNat n 0

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

@[simp] lemma inv_zero : inv 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma inv_iff_ne_zero : inv n = 0 ↔ 0 < n := by simp[inv, isEqNat, zero_lt_iff]

@[simp] lemma inv_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : inv n = 0 := by simp[inv, isEqNat, h]

@[simp] lemma pos_zero : pos 0 = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pos_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : pos n = 1 := by simp[pos, isLtNat, h]

def and (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n * m)

def or (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n + m)

lemma and_eq (n m : ℕ) : and n m = if 0 < n ∧ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp [mul_pos_iff, and, isLtNat]

lemma and_eq_one (n m : ℕ) : and n m = 1 ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq, imp_false, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

lemma or_eq (n m : ℕ) : or n m = if 0 < n ∨ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp[or, isLtNat]

@[simp] lemma and_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < and n m ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∧ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma or_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < or n m ↔ 0 < n ∨ 0 < m := by simp[or_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∨ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop

  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)
  | add {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i + v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | mul {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i * v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)

    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

lemma pos_of_eq_one (h : n = 1) : 0 < n := by simp[h]

def isEqNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n = m then 1 else 0

def isLtNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n < m then 1 else 0

def isLeNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

def isDvdNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∣ m then 1 else 0

@[simp] lemma isEqNat_pos_iff : 0 < isEqNat n m ↔ n = m := by simp[isEqNat]; by_cases n = m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLtNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLtNat n m ↔ n < m := by simp[isLtNat]; by_cases n < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLeNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLeNat n m ↔ n ≤ m := by simp[isLeNat]; by_cases n ≤ m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isDvdNat_pos_iff : 0 < isDvdNat n m ↔ n ∣ m := by simp[isDvdNat]; by_cases n ∣ m <;> simp[*]

def inv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isEqNat n 0

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

@[simp] lemma inv_zero : inv 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma inv_iff_ne_zero : inv n = 0 ↔ 0 < n := by simp[inv, isEqNat, zero_lt_iff]

@[simp] lemma inv_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : inv n = 0 := by simp[inv, isEqNat, h]

@[simp] lemma pos_zero : pos 0 = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pos_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : pos n = 1 := by simp[pos, isLtNat, h]

def and (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n * m)

def or (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n + m)

lemma and_eq (n m : ℕ) : and n m = if 0 < n ∧ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp [mul_pos_iff, and, isLtNat]

lemma and_eq_one (n m : ℕ) : and n m = 1 ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq, imp_false, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

lemma or_eq (n m : ℕ) : or n m = if 0 < n ∨ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp[or, isLtNat]

@[simp] lemma and_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < and n m ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∧ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma or_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < or n m ↔ 0 < n ∨ 0 < m := by simp[or_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∨ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma inv_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < inv n ↔ ¬0 < n := by simp[inv]

@[simp] lemma pos_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < pos n ↔ 0 < n := by simp[pos]

def ball (n : ℕ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ := n.rec 1 (fun n ih => (φ n).pos.and ih)

@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },
    by intro h; exact ⟨h n (Nat.le_refl n), fun m hm => h m (le_of_lt hm)⟩⟩

@[simp] lemma ball_eq_zero_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 0 ↔ ∃ m < n, φ m = 0 := by
  simpa[-ball_pos_iff] using not_iff_not.mpr (ball_pos_iff (φ := φ) (n := n))

lemma ball_pos_iff_eq_one {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 1 ↔ 0 < ball n φ := by
  induction' n with n _ <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · constructor
    · intro h; simpa using pos_of_eq_one h
    · intro h; simpa[and_eq_one] using h

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop
  | zero {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 0)
  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)
  | add {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i + v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | mul {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i * v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | comp {m n f} (g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ) :
    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

def Arith₁ (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) := ArithPart₁ (n := n) f

end Nat

open Primrec

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma of_eq {n} {f g : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) (H : ∀ i, f i = g i) : ArithPart₁ g :=
  (funext H : f = g) ▸ hf

lemma bind (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).bind (f v) :=
  (hf.comp (g :> fun i v => v.get i) (fun i => by cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*]; exact proj _)).of_eq (by
    intro v; simp
    rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (hgv | ⟨x, hgv⟩)
    · simp[hgv, List.Vector.mOfFn]
    · simp[hgv, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
      have : List.Vector.mOfFn (fun i => (g :> fun j v => Part.some $ v.get j) i v) = pure (List.Vector.ofFn (x :> fun j => v.get j)) := by
        rw[←List.Vector.mOfFn_pure]; apply congr_arg
        funext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[hgv]
      simp[this])

lemma map (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : @Arith₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).map (f v) :=
  (bind (Part.some $ f · ·) (hf.of_eq <| by simp) hg).of_eq <| by
  intro v; rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (_ | ⟨x, _⟩) <;> simp[*]

    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => f (g v) :=

          funext j; cases j using Fin.cases <;> simp[Fin.eq_zero]

    ArithPart₁ (fun v => Nat.rfind fun n => Part.some (f n v = 0)) := rfind h

lemma rfind'₁ {n} (i : Fin n) {f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (h : Arith₁ (n := 2) (fun v => f (v.get 0) (v.get 1))) :

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma bind (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).bind (f v) :=
  (hf.comp (g :> fun i v => v.get i) (fun i => by cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*]; exact proj _)).of_eq (by
    intro v; simp
    rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (hgv | ⟨x, hgv⟩)
    · simp[hgv, List.Vector.mOfFn]
    · simp[hgv, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
      have : List.Vector.mOfFn (fun i => (g :> fun j v => Part.some $ v.get j) i v) = pure (List.Vector.ofFn (x :> fun j => v.get j)) := by
        rw[←List.Vector.mOfFn_pure]; apply congr_arg
        funext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[hgv]
      simp[this])

open Primrec

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma of_eq {n} {f g : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) (H : ∀ i, f i = g i) : ArithPart₁ g :=
  (funext H : f = g) ▸ hf

lemma bind (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).bind (f v) :=
  (hf.comp (g :> fun i v => v.get i) (fun i => by cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*]; exact proj _)).of_eq (by
    intro v; simp
    rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (hgv | ⟨x, hgv⟩)
    · simp[hgv, List.Vector.mOfFn]
    · simp[hgv, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
      have : List.Vector.mOfFn (fun i => (g :> fun j v => Part.some $ v.get j) i v) = pure (List.Vector.ofFn (x :> fun j => v.get j)) := by
        rw[←List.Vector.mOfFn_pure]; apply congr_arg
        funext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[hgv]
      simp[this])

lemma map (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : @Arith₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).map (f v) :=
  (bind (Part.some $ f · ·) (hf.of_eq <| by simp) hg).of_eq <| by
  intro v; rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (_ | ⟨x, _⟩) <;> simp[*]

lemma comp₁ (f : ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ 1 fun v => f (v.get 0)) {n g} (hg : @Arith₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => f (g v) :=
  (hf.comp _ fun _ => hg).of_eq (by simp)

lemma comp₂ (f : ℕ → ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ 2 fun v => f (v.get 0) (v.get 1)) {n g h} (hg : @Arith₁ n g) (hh : @Arith₁ n h) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => f (g v) (h v) :=
  (hf.comp ![g, h] (fun i => i.cases hg (fun i => by simpa using hh))).of_eq
    (by intro i
        have : (fun j => (![↑g, h] : Fin 2 → List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) j i) = (fun j => pure (![g i, h i] j)) := by
          funext j; cases j using Fin.cases <;> simp[Fin.eq_zero]
        simp[Matrix.comp_vecCons']; simp[this] )

lemma rfind' {n} {f : ℕ → List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ} (h : Arith₁ (n := n + 1) (fun v => f v.head v.tail)) :
    ArithPart₁ (fun v => Nat.rfind fun n => Part.some (f n v = 0)) := rfind h

lemma rfind'₁ {n} (i : Fin n) {f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (h : Arith₁ (n := 2) (fun v => f (v.get 0) (v.get 1))) :
    ArithPart₁ (fun v => Nat.rfind fun n => Part.some (f n (v.get i) = 0)) :=
  (rfind h).comp₁ (fun m => Nat.rfind fun n => Part.some (f n m = 0)) (proj i)

/--
`List.Vector α n` is the type of lists of length `n` with elements of type `α`.

Note that there is also `Vector α n` in the root namespace,
which is the type of *arrays* of length `n` with elements of type `α`.

Typically, if you are doing programming or verification, you will primarily use `Vector α n`,
and if you are doing mathematics, you may want to use `List.Vector α n` instead.
-/

  { l : List α // l.length = n }

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

  (hf.comp (g :> fun i v => v.get i) (fun i => by cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*]; exact proj _)).of_eq (by
    intro v; simp
    rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (hgv | ⟨x, hgv⟩)
    · simp[hgv, List.Vector.mOfFn]
    · simp[hgv, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
      have : List.Vector.mOfFn (fun i => (g :> fun j v => Part.some $ v.get j) i v) = pure (List.Vector.ofFn (x :> fun j => v.get j)) := by
        rw[←List.Vector.mOfFn_pure]; apply congr_arg

      simp[this])

  (hf.comp (g :> fun i v => v.get i) (fun i => by cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*]; exact proj _)).of_eq (by
    intro v; simp
    rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (hgv | ⟨x, hgv⟩)

/--
`List.Vector α n` is the type of lists of length `n` with elements of type `α`.

Note that there is also `Vector α n` in the root namespace,
which is the type of *arrays* of length `n` with elements of type `α`.

Typically, if you are doing programming or verification, you will primarily use `Vector α n`,
and if you are doing mathematics, you may want to use `List.Vector α n` instead.
-/
def List.Vector (α : Type u) (n : ℕ) :=
  { l : List α // l.length = n }

  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)

      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))

  case proj n i =>

      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)

    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec

import Foundation.Vorspiel.Vorspiel
import Mathlib.Computability.Halting
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.List.FinRange
import Mathlib.Logic.Godel.GodelBetaFunction

open Mathlib List.Vector Part

namespace Nat

lemma pos_of_eq_one (h : n = 1) : 0 < n := by simp[h]

def isEqNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n = m then 1 else 0

def isLtNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n < m then 1 else 0

def isLeNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

def isDvdNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∣ m then 1 else 0

@[simp] lemma isEqNat_pos_iff : 0 < isEqNat n m ↔ n = m := by simp[isEqNat]; by_cases n = m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLtNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLtNat n m ↔ n < m := by simp[isLtNat]; by_cases n < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLeNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLeNat n m ↔ n ≤ m := by simp[isLeNat]; by_cases n ≤ m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isDvdNat_pos_iff : 0 < isDvdNat n m ↔ n ∣ m := by simp[isDvdNat]; by_cases n ∣ m <;> simp[*]

def inv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isEqNat n 0

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

@[simp] lemma inv_zero : inv 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma inv_iff_ne_zero : inv n = 0 ↔ 0 < n := by simp[inv, isEqNat, zero_lt_iff]

@[simp] lemma inv_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : inv n = 0 := by simp[inv, isEqNat, h]

@[simp] lemma pos_zero : pos 0 = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pos_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : pos n = 1 := by simp[pos, isLtNat, h]

def and (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n * m)

def or (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n + m)

lemma and_eq (n m : ℕ) : and n m = if 0 < n ∧ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp [mul_pos_iff, and, isLtNat]

lemma and_eq_one (n m : ℕ) : and n m = 1 ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq, imp_false, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

lemma or_eq (n m : ℕ) : or n m = if 0 < n ∨ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp[or, isLtNat]

@[simp] lemma and_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < and n m ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∧ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma or_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < or n m ↔ 0 < n ∨ 0 < m := by simp[or_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∨ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma inv_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < inv n ↔ ¬0 < n := by simp[inv]

@[simp] lemma pos_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < pos n ↔ 0 < n := by simp[pos]

def ball (n : ℕ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ := n.rec 1 (fun n ih => (φ n).pos.and ih)

@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },
    by intro h; exact ⟨h n (Nat.le_refl n), fun m hm => h m (le_of_lt hm)⟩⟩

  induction' n with n _ <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · constructor
    · intro h; simpa using pos_of_eq_one h
    · intro h; simpa[and_eq_one] using h

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop
  | zero {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 0)
  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)
  | add {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i + v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | mul {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i * v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | comp {m n f} (g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ) :
    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

def Arith₁ (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) := ArithPart₁ (n := n) f

end Nat

namespace Nat.ArithPart₁

open Primrec

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma of_eq {n} {f g : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) (H : ∀ i, f i = g i) : ArithPart₁ g :=
  (funext H : f = g) ▸ hf

lemma bind (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).bind (f v) :=
  (hf.comp (g :> fun i v => v.get i) (fun i => by cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*]; exact proj _)).of_eq (by
    intro v; simp
    rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (hgv | ⟨x, hgv⟩)
    · simp[hgv, List.Vector.mOfFn]
    · simp[hgv, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
      have : List.Vector.mOfFn (fun i => (g :> fun j v => Part.some $ v.get j) i v) = pure (List.Vector.ofFn (x :> fun j => v.get j)) := by
        rw[←List.Vector.mOfFn_pure]; apply congr_arg
        funext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[hgv]
      simp[this])

lemma map (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : @Arith₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).map (f v) :=
  (bind (Part.some $ f · ·) (hf.of_eq <| by simp) hg).of_eq <| by
  intro v; rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (_ | ⟨x, _⟩) <;> simp[*]

lemma comp₁ (f : ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ 1 fun v => f (v.get 0)) {n g} (hg : @Arith₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => f (g v) :=
  (hf.comp _ fun _ => hg).of_eq (by simp)

lemma comp₂ (f : ℕ → ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ 2 fun v => f (v.get 0) (v.get 1)) {n g h} (hg : @Arith₁ n g) (hh : @Arith₁ n h) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => f (g v) (h v) :=
  (hf.comp ![g, h] (fun i => i.cases hg (fun i => by simpa using hh))).of_eq
    (by intro i
        have : (fun j => (![↑g, h] : Fin 2 → List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) j i) = (fun j => pure (![g i, h i] j)) := by
          funext j; cases j using Fin.cases <;> simp[Fin.eq_zero]
        simp[Matrix.comp_vecCons']; simp[this] )

lemma rfind' {n} {f : ℕ → List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ} (h : Arith₁ (n := n + 1) (fun v => f v.head v.tail)) :
    ArithPart₁ (fun v => Nat.rfind fun n => Part.some (f n v = 0)) := rfind h

lemma rfind'₁ {n} (i : Fin n) {f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (h : Arith₁ (n := 2) (fun v => f (v.get 0) (v.get 1))) :
    ArithPart₁ (fun v => Nat.rfind fun n => Part.some (f n (v.get i) = 0)) :=
  (rfind h).comp₁ (fun m => Nat.rfind fun n => Part.some (f n m = 0)) (proj i)

end Nat.ArithPart₁

namespace Nat.Arith₁

lemma of_eq {n} {f g : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ} (hf : Arith₁ f) (H : ∀ i, f i = g i) : Arith₁ g := by exact?

/--
**Function extensionality** is the statement that if two functions take equal values
every point, then the functions themselves are equal: `(∀ x, f x = g x) → f = g`.
It is called "extensionality" because it talks about how to prove two objects are equal
based on the properties of the object (compare with set extensionality,
which is `(∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ t) → s = t`).

This is often an axiom in dependent type theory systems, because it cannot be proved
from the core logic alone. However in lean's type theory this follows from the existence
of quotient types (note the `Quot.sound` in the proof, as well as the `show` line
which makes use of the definitional equality `Quot.lift f h (Quot.mk x) = f x`).
-/
theorem funext {α : Sort u} {β : α → Sort v} {f g : (x : α) → β x}
    (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : f = g := by
  let eqv (f g : (x : α) → β x) := ∀ x, f x = g x
  let extfunApp (f : Quot eqv) (x : α) : β x :=
    Quot.liftOn f
      (fun (f : ∀ (x : α), β x) => f x)
      (fun _ _ h => h x)
  show extfunApp (Quot.mk eqv f) = extfunApp (Quot.mk eqv g)
  exact congrArg extfunApp (Quot.sound h)

C1_dependencies.name: List.Vector
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`List.Vector α n` is the type of lists of length `n` with elements of type `α`.

Note that there is also `Vector α n` in the root namespace,
which is the type of *arrays* of length `n` with elements of type `α`.

Typically, if you are doing programming or verification, you will primarily use `Vector α n`,
and if you are doing mathematics, you may want to use `List.Vector α n` instead.
-/
def List.Vector (α : Type u) (n : ℕ) :=
  { l : List α // l.length = n }

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma lt_of_eq_natToVec {e : ℕ} {v : Fin n → ℕ} (h : e.natToVec n = some v) (i : Fin n) : v i < e := by
  induction' n with n ih generalizing e
  · exact i.elim0
  · cases' e with e
    · simp [natToVec] at h
    · simp only [natToVec, Option.map_eq_some'] at h
      rcases h with ⟨v, hnv, rfl⟩
      cases' i using Fin.cases with i
      · simp [lt_succ, unpair_left_le]
      · simp only [cons_val_succ]
        exact lt_trans (ih hnv i) (lt_succ.mpr <| unpair_right_le e)

For instance, `![a, b, c] : Fin 3` is syntax for `vecCons a (vecCons b (vecCons c vecEmpty))`.

The `!![a, b; c, d]` syntax (provided by `Matrix.matrixNotation`) should be used instead.

protected instance _root_.PiFin.toExpr [ToLevel.{u}] [ToExpr α] (n : ℕ) : ToExpr (Fin n → α) :=
  have lu := toLevel.{u}
  have eα : Q(Type $lu) := toTypeExpr α
  have toTypeExpr := q(Fin $n → $eα)
  match n with
  | 0 => { toTypeExpr, toExpr := fun _ => q(@vecEmpty $eα) }
  | n + 1 =>
    { toTypeExpr, toExpr := fun v =>
      have := PiFin.toExpr n
      have eh : Q($eα) := toExpr (vecHead v)
      have et : Q(Fin $n → $eα) := toExpr (vecTail v)
      q(vecCons $eh $et) }

informal_statement: For any natural number \( n \), the vector space of \( 1 \times n \) matrices has a dimension of \( 1 \).
informal_proof:
To prove that for any natural number \( n \), the vector space of \( 1 \times n \) matrices has a dimension of \( 1 \), we proceed as follows:

1. **Understanding the Vector Space**: The vector space in question consists of all \( 1 \times n \) matrices, which can be thought of as row vectors with \( n \) entries from a given field (assumed to be the real numbers for simplicity).

2. **Definition of Dimension**: The dimension of a vector space is the number of vectors in any basis for that space.

3. **Identifying a Basis**: Consider the set containing a single vector \( \mathbf{e}_1 = [1, 0, 0, \ldots, 0] \). This vector acts as a basis for the vector space.

4. **Spanning Set**: Any \( 1 \times n \) matrix can be expressed as a scalar multiple of \( \mathbf{e}_1 \). For example, \( [a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n] = a_1 \mathbf{e}_1 + a_2 \cdot 0 + \ldots + a_n \cdot 0 \).

5. **Linear Independence**: The vector \( \mathbf{e}_1 \) is linearly independent because the only scalar multiple that results in the zero vector is the scalar \( 0 \).

6. **Uniqueness of Basis**: Since \( \mathbf{e}_1 \) spans the entire space and is linearly independent, it forms a unique basis for the vector space.

7. **Number of Basis Vectors**: There is exactly one such basis vector, hence the dimension of the vector space is \( 1 \).

8. **Conclusion**: Therefore, for any natural number \( n \), the vector space of \( 1 \times n \) matrices has a dimension of \( 1 \).

  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)

  | mul {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i * v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)

  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)

      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))

        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)

    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

rag.name: Mathlib.Notation3.matchScoped
rag.content:
/-- Matcher for processing `scoped` syntax. Assumes the expression to be matched
against is in the `lit` variable.

Runs `smatcher`, extracts the resulting `scopeId` variable, processes this value
(which must be a lambda) to produce a binder, and loops. -/
partial def matchScoped (lit scopeId : Name) (smatcher : Matcher) : Matcher := go #[] where
  /-- Variant of `matchScoped` after some number of `binders` have already been captured. -/
  go (binders : Array (TSyntax ``extBinderParenthesized)) : Matcher := fun s => do
    -- `lit` is bound to the SubExpr that the `scoped` syntax produced
    s.withVar lit do
    try
      -- Run `smatcher` at `lit`, clearing the `scopeId` variable so that it can get a fresh value
      let s ← smatcher {s with vars := s.vars.erase scopeId}
      s.withVar scopeId do
        guard (← getExpr).isLambda
        let prop ← try Meta.isProp (← getExpr).bindingDomain! catch _ => pure false
        let isDep := (← getExpr).bindingBody!.hasLooseBVar 0
        let ppTypes ← getPPOption getPPPiBinderTypes -- the same option controlling ∀
        let dom ← withBindingDomain delab
        withBindingBodyUnusedName fun x => do
          let x : Ident := ⟨x⟩
          let binder ←
            if prop && !isDep then
              -- this underscore is used to support binder predicates, since it indicates
              -- the variable is unused and this binder is safe to merge into another
              `(extBinderParenthesized|(_ : $dom))
            else if prop || ppTypes then
              `(extBinderParenthesized|($x:ident : $dom))
            else
              `(extBinderParenthesized|($x:ident))
          -- Now use the body of the lambda for `lit` for the next iteration
          let s ← s.captureSubexpr lit
          -- TODO merge binders as an inverse to `satisfies_binder_pred%`
          let binders := binders.push binder
          go binders s
    catch _ =>
      guard <| !binders.isEmpty
      if let some binders₂ := s.scopeState then
        guard <| binders == binders₂ -- TODO: this might be a bit too strict, but it seems to work
        return s
      else
        return {s with scopeState := binders}

lemma pos_of_eq_one (h : n = 1) : 0 < n := by simp[h]

def isEqNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n = m then 1 else 0

def isLtNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n < m then 1 else 0

def isLeNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

def isDvdNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∣ m then 1 else 0

@[simp] lemma isEqNat_pos_iff : 0 < isEqNat n m ↔ n = m := by simp[isEqNat]; by_cases n = m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLtNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLtNat n m ↔ n < m := by simp[isLtNat]; by_cases n < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLeNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLeNat n m ↔ n ≤ m := by simp[isLeNat]; by_cases n ≤ m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isDvdNat_pos_iff : 0 < isDvdNat n m ↔ n ∣ m := by simp[isDvdNat]; by_cases n ∣ m <;> simp[*]

def inv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isEqNat n 0

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

@[simp] lemma inv_zero : inv 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma inv_iff_ne_zero : inv n = 0 ↔ 0 < n := by simp[inv, isEqNat, zero_lt_iff]

@[simp] lemma inv_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : inv n = 0 := by simp[inv, isEqNat, h]

@[simp] lemma pos_zero : pos 0 = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pos_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : pos n = 1 := by simp[pos, isLtNat, h]

def and (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n * m)

def or (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n + m)

lemma and_eq (n m : ℕ) : and n m = if 0 < n ∧ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp [mul_pos_iff, and, isLtNat]

lemma and_eq_one (n m : ℕ) : and n m = 1 ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq, imp_false, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

lemma or_eq (n m : ℕ) : or n m = if 0 < n ∨ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp[or, isLtNat]

@[simp] lemma and_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < and n m ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∧ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma or_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < or n m ↔ 0 < n ∨ 0 < m := by simp[or_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∨ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma inv_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < inv n ↔ ¬0 < n := by simp[inv]

@[simp] lemma pos_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < pos n ↔ 0 < n := by simp[pos]

def ball (n : ℕ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ := n.rec 1 (fun n ih => (φ n).pos.and ih)

@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },
    by intro h; exact ⟨h n (Nat.le_refl n), fun m hm => h m (le_of_lt hm)⟩⟩

@[simp] lemma ball_eq_zero_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 0 ↔ ∃ m < n, φ m = 0 := by
  simpa[-ball_pos_iff] using not_iff_not.mpr (ball_pos_iff (φ := φ) (n := n))

lemma ball_pos_iff_eq_one {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 1 ↔ 0 < ball n φ := by
  induction' n with n _ <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · constructor
    · intro h; simpa using pos_of_eq_one h
    · intro h; simpa[and_eq_one] using h

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop
  | zero {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 0)
  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)
  | add {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i + v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | mul {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i * v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | comp {m n f} (g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ) :
    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

def Arith₁ (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) := ArithPart₁ (n := n) f

  case add n i j =>

      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))

@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop

  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)

  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)

    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },
    by intro h; exact ⟨h n (Nat.le_refl n), fun m hm => h m (le_of_lt hm)⟩⟩

@[simp] lemma ball_eq_zero_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 0 ↔ ∃ m < n, φ m = 0 := by
  simpa[-ball_pos_iff] using not_iff_not.mpr (ball_pos_iff (φ := φ) (n := n))

lemma ball_pos_iff_eq_one {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 1 ↔ 0 < ball n φ := by
  induction' n with n _ <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · constructor
    · intro h; simpa using pos_of_eq_one h
    · intro h; simpa[and_eq_one] using h

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop
  | zero {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 0)
  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)
  | add {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i + v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | mul {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i * v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | comp {m n f} (g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ) :
    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

def Arith₁ (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) := ArithPart₁ (n := n) f

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma of_eq {n} {f g : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) (H : ∀ i, f i = g i) : ArithPart₁ g :=
  (funext H : f = g) ▸ hf

lemma bind (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).bind (f v) :=
  (hf.comp (g :> fun i v => v.get i) (fun i => by cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*]; exact proj _)).of_eq (by
    intro v; simp
    rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (hgv | ⟨x, hgv⟩)
    · simp[hgv, List.Vector.mOfFn]
    · simp[hgv, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
      have : List.Vector.mOfFn (fun i => (g :> fun j v => Part.some $ v.get j) i v) = pure (List.Vector.ofFn (x :> fun j => v.get j)) := by
        rw[←List.Vector.mOfFn_pure]; apply congr_arg
        funext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[hgv]
      simp[this])

lemma map (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : @Arith₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).map (f v) :=
  (bind (Part.some $ f · ·) (hf.of_eq <| by simp) hg).of_eq <| by
  intro v; rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (_ | ⟨x, _⟩) <;> simp[*]

/--
`List.Vector α n` is the type of lists of length `n` with elements of type `α`.

Note that there is also `Vector α n` in the root namespace,
which is the type of *arrays* of length `n` with elements of type `α`.

Typically, if you are doing programming or verification, you will primarily use `Vector α n`,
and if you are doing mathematics, you may want to use `List.Vector α n` instead.

  { l : List α // l.length = n }

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma bind (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : @ArithPart₁ (n + 1) fun v => f v.tail v.head) {g} (hg : @ArithPart₁ n g) :
    @ArithPart₁ n fun v => (g v).bind (f v) :=
  (hf.comp (g :> fun i v => v.get i) (fun i => by cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*]; exact proj _)).of_eq (by
    intro v; simp
    rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some (g v) with (hgv | ⟨x, hgv⟩)
    · simp[hgv, List.Vector.mOfFn]
    · simp[hgv, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
      have : List.Vector.mOfFn (fun i => (g :> fun j v => Part.some $ v.get j) i v) = pure (List.Vector.ofFn (x :> fun j => v.get j)) := by
        rw[←List.Vector.mOfFn_pure]; apply congr_arg
        funext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[hgv]
      simp[this])

rag.content:
theorem rfindOpt {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} (hf : @Partrec' (n + 1) f) :
    @Partrec' n fun v => Nat.rfindOpt fun a => ofNat (Option ℕ) (f (a ::ᵥ v)) :=
  ((rfind <|
        (of_prim (Primrec.nat_sub.comp (_root_.Primrec.const 1) Primrec.vector_head)).comp₁
          (fun n => Part.some (1 - n)) hf).bind
    ((prim Nat.Primrec'.pred).comp₁ Nat.pred hf)).of_eq
    fun v =>
    Part.ext fun b => by
      simp only [Nat.rfindOpt, exists_prop, Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le, PFun.coe_val, Part.mem_bind_iff,
        Part.mem_some_iff, Option.mem_def, Part.mem_coe]
      refine
        exists_congr fun a => (and_congr (iff_of_eq ?_) Iff.rfl).trans (and_congr_right fun h => ?_)
      · congr
        funext n
        cases f (n ::ᵥ v) <;> simp [Nat.succ_le_succ] <;> rfl
      · have := Nat.rfind_spec h
        simp only [Part.coe_some, Part.mem_some_iff] at this

/-- **Rice's Theorem** -/
theorem rice (C : Set (ℕ →. ℕ)) (h : ComputablePred fun c => eval c ∈ C) {f g} (hf : Nat.Partrec f)
    (hg : Nat.Partrec g) (fC : f ∈ C) : g ∈ C := by
  obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨c, e⟩ :=
    fixed_point₂
      (Partrec.cond (h.comp fst) ((Partrec.nat_iff.2 hg).comp snd).to₂
          ((Partrec.nat_iff.2 hf).comp snd).to₂).to₂
  simp only [Bool.cond_decide] at e
  by_cases H : eval c ∈ C
  · simp only [H, if_true] at e
    change (fun b => g b) ∈ C
    rwa [← e]
  · simp only [H, if_false] at e
    rw [e] at H
    contradiction

informal_statement: Given a function `f` that takes a natural number `n` and a vector of natural numbers of length `n`, the `ArithPart₁` function with respect to `f` is equivalent to the `rfind` function that lookups the condition where `f n v = 0`.
informal_proof: By applying the definition of `rfind`, which searches through the vector `v` for an element where `f n v` equals zero, and returns `Part.some` if such an element is found, otherwise returns `n`, we directly obtain the desired result as `ArithPart₁` essentially performs the same operation. Hence, `ArithPart₁` of the given condition equals `rfind` as defined.

lemma pos_of_eq_one (h : n = 1) : 0 < n := by simp[h]

def isEqNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n = m then 1 else 0

def isLtNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n < m then 1 else 0

def isLeNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

def isDvdNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∣ m then 1 else 0

@[simp] lemma isEqNat_pos_iff : 0 < isEqNat n m ↔ n = m := by simp[isEqNat]; by_cases n = m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLtNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLtNat n m ↔ n < m := by simp[isLtNat]; by_cases n < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLeNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLeNat n m ↔ n ≤ m := by simp[isLeNat]; by_cases n ≤ m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isDvdNat_pos_iff : 0 < isDvdNat n m ↔ n ∣ m := by simp[isDvdNat]; by_cases n ∣ m <;> simp[*]

def inv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isEqNat n 0

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

informal_statement: For any function \( f \) that takes two elements and a structure \( ![g, h] \) that holds two functions \( g \) and \( h \), applying \( f \) to the outputs of \( g \) and \( h \) is equivalent to first applying \( f \) to the pair \( ![g, h] \) and then interpreting it.
informal_proof:
To understand this, let's break it down. Suppose we have two functions \( g \) and \( h \), and another function \( f \) that takes two elements. The structure \( ![g, h] \) presumably contains these two functions. 

When we apply \( f \) to \( g \) and \( h \) individually, we get \( f(g(v), h(v)) \) for some value \( v \). On the other hand, applying \( f \) to the structure \( ![g, h] \) would also give \( f(g(v), h(v)) \). Since both operations result in the same value, they are equivalent.

This equivalence holds because both methods ultimately rely on applying \( f \) to the outcomes of \( g \) and \( h \), without any additional transformations beyond what's necessary for interpretation.

  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },
    by intro h; exact ⟨h n (Nat.le_refl n), fun m hm => h m (le_of_lt hm)⟩⟩

@[simp] lemma ball_eq_zero_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 0 ↔ ∃ m < n, φ m = 0 := by
  simpa[-ball_pos_iff] using not_iff_not.mpr (ball_pos_iff (φ := φ) (n := n))

lemma ball_pos_iff_eq_one {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 1 ↔ 0 < ball n φ := by
  induction' n with n _ <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · constructor
    · intro h; simpa using pos_of_eq_one h
    · intro h; simpa[and_eq_one] using h

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop
  | zero {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 0)
  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)
  | add {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i + v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | mul {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i * v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | comp {m n f} (g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ) :
    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

def Arith₁ (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) := ArithPart₁ (n := n) f

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

C0_dependencies.name: Nat.ball_pos_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },
    by intro h; exact ⟨h n (Nat.le_refl n), fun m hm => h m (le_of_lt hm)⟩⟩

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

import Foundation.Vorspiel.Vorspiel
import Mathlib.Computability.Halting
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.List.FinRange
import Mathlib.Logic.Godel.GodelBetaFunction

open Mathlib List.Vector Part

namespace Nat

lemma pos_of_eq_one (h : n = 1) : 0 < n := by simp[h]

def isEqNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n = m then 1 else 0

def isLtNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n < m then 1 else 0

def isLeNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

def isDvdNat (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∣ m then 1 else 0

@[simp] lemma isEqNat_pos_iff : 0 < isEqNat n m ↔ n = m := by simp[isEqNat]; by_cases n = m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLtNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLtNat n m ↔ n < m := by simp[isLtNat]; by_cases n < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isLeNat_pos_iff : 0 < isLeNat n m ↔ n ≤ m := by simp[isLeNat]; by_cases n ≤ m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma isDvdNat_pos_iff : 0 < isDvdNat n m ↔ n ∣ m := by simp[isDvdNat]; by_cases n ∣ m <;> simp[*]

def inv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isEqNat n 0

def pos (n : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 n

@[simp] lemma inv_zero : inv 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma inv_iff_ne_zero : inv n = 0 ↔ 0 < n := by simp[inv, isEqNat, zero_lt_iff]

@[simp] lemma inv_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : inv n = 0 := by simp[inv, isEqNat, h]

@[simp] lemma pos_zero : pos 0 = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pos_ne_zero (h : n ≠ 0) : pos n = 1 := by simp[pos, isLtNat, h]

def and (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n * m)

def or (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := isLtNat 0 (n + m)

lemma and_eq (n m : ℕ) : and n m = if 0 < n ∧ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp [mul_pos_iff, and, isLtNat]

lemma and_eq_one (n m : ℕ) : and n m = 1 ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq, imp_false, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

lemma or_eq (n m : ℕ) : or n m = if 0 < n ∨ 0 < m then 1 else 0 := by simp[or, isLtNat]

@[simp] lemma and_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < and n m ↔ 0 < n ∧ 0 < m := by simp[and_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∧ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma or_pos_iff (n m : ℕ) : 0 < or n m ↔ 0 < n ∨ 0 < m := by simp[or_eq]; by_cases 0 < n ∨ 0 < m <;> simp[*]

@[simp] lemma inv_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < inv n ↔ ¬0 < n := by simp[inv]

@[simp] lemma pos_pos_iff (n : ℕ) : 0 < pos n ↔ 0 < n := by simp[pos]

def ball (n : ℕ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ := n.rec 1 (fun n ih => (φ n).pos.and ih)

@[simp] lemma ball_pos_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : 0 < ball n φ ↔ ∀ m < n, 0 < φ m := by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · simp[ih]; exact ⟨
    by rintro ⟨hn, hp⟩ m hm; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with (hm | rfl); { exact hp _ hm }; { exact hn },
    by intro h; exact ⟨h n (Nat.le_refl n), fun m hm => h m (le_of_lt hm)⟩⟩

@[simp] lemma ball_eq_zero_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 0 ↔ ∃ m < n, φ m = 0 := by
  simpa[-ball_pos_iff] using not_iff_not.mpr (ball_pos_iff (φ := φ) (n := n))

lemma ball_pos_iff_eq_one {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} : ball n φ = 1 ↔ 0 < ball n φ := by
  induction' n with n _ <;> simp[ball, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at*
  · constructor
    · intro h; simpa using pos_of_eq_one h
    · intro h; simpa[and_eq_one] using h

inductive ArithPart₁ : ∀ {n}, (List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ) → Prop
  | zero {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 0)
  | one {n} : @ArithPart₁ n (fun _ => 1)
  | add {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i + v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | mul {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i * v.get j : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | proj {n} (i : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => v.get i : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | equal {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isEqNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | lt {n} (i j : Fin n) : @ArithPart₁ n (fun v => isLtNat (v.get i) (v.get j) : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ)
  | comp {m n f} (g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ) :
    ArithPart₁ f → (∀ i, ArithPart₁ (g i)) → ArithPart₁ fun v => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => g i v) >>= f
  | rfind {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    ArithPart₁ (n := n + 1) f → ArithPart₁ (fun v => rfind fun n => Part.some (f (n ::ᵥ v) = 0))

def Arith₁ (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) := ArithPart₁ (n := n) f

end Nat

namespace Nat.ArithPart₁

open Primrec

lemma to_partrec' {n} {f : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) : Partrec' f := by
  induction hf
  case zero => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 0)
  case one  => exact Partrec'.of_part (Partrec.const' 1)
  case add n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case mul n i j =>
    exact (Partrec'.of_part ((Primrec.nat_mul.comp
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j))).to_comp.partrec))
  case proj n i =>
    exact Partrec'.of_part
      (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i)).to_comp.partrec
  case equal n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i = v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.eq.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case lt n i j =>
    have : Primrec (fun (v : List.Vector ℕ n) => if v.get i < v.get j then 1 else 0) :=
      Primrec.ite
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const i))
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp _root_.Primrec.id (_root_.Primrec.const j)))
        (_root_.Primrec.const 1)
        (_root_.Primrec.const 0)
    exact Partrec'.of_part this.to_comp.partrec
  case comp m n f g _ _ hf hg =>
    exact Partrec'.comp g hf hg
  case rfind f _ hf =>
    exact Partrec'.rfind hf

lemma of_eq {n} {f g : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ} (hf : ArithPart₁ f) (H : ∀ i, f i = g i) : ArithPart₁ g := by exact?
